newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's M1 money supply up 0.1 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: Israel's M1 money supply up 0.1 pct in May.

text.p: Israel's money supply as measured by M1 expanded only 0.1 percent in May to 18.04 billion shekels, the Bank of Israel said on Tuesday.
This compares with an 1.8 percent rise in April and a 0.8 percent decline in May 1996.
In the first five months of 1997 M1 grew 6.2 percent.
Total credit grew 1.1 percent in May to 282 billion shekels following a 2.0 percent increase in April and a 2.2 percent rise in May 1996. It was up 7.2 percent in the first five months.
